# LEO SNOW — Full Site Information

## Identity

- Name: LEO SNOW
- Taglines: "Ghana Boy With A Different Flow", "The Storm From Africa", "The global takeover begins here"
- Genre: Afrobeats, Alté, Hip-Hop, Experimental
- Origin: Ghana
- Booking: leosnowbookings@gmail.com

## Biography

Leo Snow is the storm out of Africa — where afrobeats, alté and street soul collide into one cold wave. Born in the noise, raised in the frequency, he turns every track into a blizzard of melody and motion. This isn't just music; it's a storm designed to move your pulse.

## Site structure

The official website (https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/) is a single-page dark-themed experience built around a green (#089908) accent with yellow (#FFDE21) and red (#eb0905) highlights. Scrolling from the hero triggers a cinematic zoom into the content.

### Hero
Full-screen photography per device, the LEO SNOW logo, the boxed tagline "Ghana Boy With / A Different Flow" and a Stream Latest button that jumps to the music section.

### Videos
Up to three official music videos embedded from YouTube, with a link to the artist's channel.

### Music (Releases)
Cover-art cards, each labeled with its type (Single, EP, Mixtape, Album) and year. A "Stream" toggle on each card reveals the platforms the release is available on: Spotify, Audiomack, Boomplay, Deezer, Apple Music, YouTube Music and custom links. A "Listen To Our Full Playlist" button links to streaming.

### Events (Shows)
White cards over a full-bleed event photograph: venue, date, city, a Tickets button when tickets are available, and a calendar icon that adds the show to Google or Apple Calendar as a reminder.

### About / Showcase Room
The artist's story ("I'm Leo Snow. — Afrobeats Artist") paired with a fan of showcase images. Clicking the focused card flips it open in 3D to reveal the image alongside its story; the first image carries the artist's own story. Arrow navigation walks through the images.

### Booking
A "Get in touch" panel with the booking email and a Name / Email / Message form. Submissions are stored in the site's Supabase backend.

## Platforms

- YouTube: https://youtube.com
- SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com
- Apple Music: https://music.apple.com
- BandCamp: https://bandcamp.com
- Instagram, TikTok, X (Twitter), Facebook, Threads, Snapchat: linked from the site header and hero

## Technical notes

- Static single-page site hosted on GitHub Pages
- Content served from a Supabase backend (site_content + messages tables) with realtime updates
- Structured data (JSON-LD MusicGroup + Events) injected at runtime
- Admin/management interface is not publicly linked
